notes: Fixes the real cause of the category/service auto-retranslation loop (e.g. 'Twitch' stuck re-translating and re-notifying forever): the live-site check used to treat a translation that came back identical to the default text (brand names, etc. that legitimately don't change between languages) as 'not translated', so it kept getting wiped and re-queued every hourly sync even though nothing was ever actually wrong. Now a real, fresh translation that matches the default is recognized and confirmed immediately instead of looping. Applies to category names and both service titles/descriptions. No database changes.
